mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpDsOrderInfoConfirmPopList*/ SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.PURCHASER_ID) AS PURCHASER_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, A.REF_NO AS REF_NO, A.REMARK, A.AGENT AS AGENT, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, A.ADD_TIME AS ADD_TIME, CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0)=0 THEN 'PR' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NULL THEN 'PO' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NULL THEN 'DS' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'IV' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'GR' END END END END END AS STATUS, B.ATOS_REMARK, B.ATOA_REMARK, B.DS_QTY, B.REASON_REMARK, B.BTOA_REMARK, NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY FROM DB_OFF_PO A, DB_OFF_IV B WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.ADD_DATE=#{st_add_date} AND A.SEQ=#{st_seq} AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.ADD_DATE=B.ADD_DATE AND A.SEQ=B.SEQ AND B.DS_SEQ=#{st_ds_seq}
mapper.update: /* masterMpDsOrderInfoConfirmPop_div_pstmt9 */ INSERT INTO DB_OFF_IV ( BUYER, ADD_DATE, SEQ , DS_SEQ, STATUS, ADD_TIME, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, RD_DATE, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DS_QTY, ATOS_REMARK, ATOA_REMARK, BTOA_REMARK, PO_QTY ) VALUES ( #{st_buyer}, --1 : BUYER #{st_add_date}, --2 : ADD_DATE ${st_seq}, SEQ_DB_OFF_IV.NEXTVAL, 'C', #{st_add_time}, --3 : ADD_TIME #{st_byit_comorg_code}, --2 : BYIT_COMORG_CODE #{st_contract_no}, --3 : CONTRACT_NO #{st_contract_seq}, --3 : CONTRACT_SEQ #{st_rd_date}, --4 : RD_DATE #{st_buyer_item_no}, --5 : BUYER_ITEM_NO ${st_ds_qty}, --6 : DS_QTY #{st_atos_remark}, --7 : ATOS_REMARK #{st_atoa_remark}, --8 : ATOA_REMARK #{st_btoa_remark}, -- : BTOA_REMARK ${st_ds_qty} --9 : PO_QTY )
